scope: One disposable Kubernetes v1.36.1 Kind cluster exercises inert repository, publisher, and registry-namespace/CID approval records. Immutable ConfigMap proposals are read by a restricted review Job. An isolated publisher Job can patch only the named allowlist ConfigMap; a separate unprivileged Job is denied. Red, green, and positive observations use the same in-cluster API path. This tests fixture policy evaluation, Kubernetes authorization, and persistence only; it does not establish that the named approver is a real person or that the documented evidence is true.

checks.claim: Kubernetes refuses mutation of the immutable source proposal
With criteria enforcement inactive, the publisher accepts and persists the same well-formed but incomplete source record
The same publisher rejects an incomplete record under the documented criteria
The same publisher rejects a complete record without approved status
An unprivileged Job identity cannot patch the allowlist ConfigMap
Approved repository, publisher, and registry namespace/CID records persist with criteria, approver, and evidence references
